title: 2023年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goals and enhance your overall performance. But before you go out and find an entrepreneur to outcompete, it's important to understand and avoid the traps that often come with rivalry. After all, competitive rivalry can also hinder effective decision-making and increase your willingness to take risks, behaviors that can ultimately hurt your venture's success.

P2 Finding someone you're committed to outcompeting can be a great way to stay focused on your goals and push your venture to the next level. But when you're intently focused on outperforming your rivals, you may begin to develop a "win-at-all-costs" mentality that causes you to ignore how you achieve success. One group of researchers, for example, examined the link between rivalry and unethical behavior. They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win. But such behavior may stain your reputation and strain relationships important to your success. One way to avoid this trap is to stop and reflect on what's important. While outperforming your rivals may provide short-term benefits, the loss of your integrity will have long-term consequences.

P3 One reason having a rival can enhance your venture's performance is that it creates a level of excitement that drives you to work harder. But this eagerness to win may also hurt your venture's success, particularly when it causes you to make impulsive, insensible decisions. But it's possible to avoid such costly mistakes by making a habit of engaging in critical thinking, such as considering opposing viewpoints and conducting cost-benefit analyses, especially for those decisions that are complex and can determine the future of your venture.

P4 The sense of eagerness that comes with having a rival can not only cause you to make poorer decisions, but it can also lead you to take greater risks that put your venture in peril. One way you can overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry that stand to endanger your venture's success is to remain attentive to your emotional state and actively monitor how such feelings are affecting your decision- making.

questions.q: How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs according to the passage?
options: By enabling them to outcompete other entrepreneurs.
By enabling them to make their venture a success.
By helping them to reach long-term goals.
By helping them to stay goal-oriented.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs 问的是"靠什么具体方式带来好处"， 答案是文中某句客观陈述，属细节题。

【拆句】主干是 How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs，competitive rivalry（竞争 性的对手关系）作主语，benefit 在这里是动词"使……受益"，entrepreneurs（创业者）是 宾语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。 46. How can competitive rivalry benefit entrepreneurs according to the passage? A) By enabling them to outcompete other entrepreneurs. B) By enabling them to make their venture a success. C) By helping them to reach long-term goals. D) By helping them to stay goal-oriented.

【定位】Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goals and enhance your overall performance. 有一个竞争对手能让你持续专注于实现自己的目标，并提升你的整体表现。

【选项】A) 答非所问 By enabling them to outcompete other entrepreneurs"使其胜过其他创业者"是"拥 有对手"的前提情境，文章首段说的好处是专注目标、提升表现，不是"胜过别人"本身。 B) 过度推断 By enabling them to make their venture a success"使其事业成功"是夸大结果；原文 只说 enhance your overall performance"提升表现"，并未说能"让事业成功"。 C) 无中生有 By helping them to reach long-term goals 多出 long-term"长期"这一限定；原文 achieving your goals 只说"目标"，并未区分长期短期。 D) ✓ 正确 keep you committed to achieving your goals ↔helping them to stay goal-oriented 四项中只有 helping them to stay goal-oriented 准确对应定位句"保持专注目标"这一 好处，与预判一致。 创业者在与对手竞争时可能经常陷入的陷阱之一是什么? A) 他们可能会采用注定会毁掉自己事业的策略。 B) 他们可能会诉诸不道德的手段来超越对手。 C) 他们可能过于急切地想要成功而忽视了巨大的人力成本。 D) 他们可能过度专注于在当前市场层面上获胜。

questions.q: What is one of the traps entrepreneurs may often fall into when competing with rivals?
options: They may adopt strategies that are bound to ruin their venture.
They may resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals.
They may be too eager to succeed while ignoring the huge labor cost.
They may be intently focused on winning at the current market level.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is one of the traps 问的是文中列出的某一个具体陷阱，答案直接来自原文陈述，属 细节题。

【拆句】What is one of the traps entrepreneurs may often fall into when competing with rivals：主干问 What is one of the traps，后接 entrepreneurs…fall into 是省略了关系词 的定语从句修饰 traps，when competing 是时间状语。fall into a trap 是固定搭配"落入 陷阱"。

【定位】They found that when people compete against their rivals, they are more willing to behave unethically to win. 他们发现，当人们与对手竞争时，更愿意为了取胜而采取不道德的行为。 47. What is one of the traps entrepreneurs may often fall into when competing with rivals? A) They may adopt strategies that are bound to ruin their venture. B) They may resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals. C) They may be too eager to succeed while ignoring the huge labor cost. D) They may be intently focused on winning at the current market level.

【选项】A) 过度推断 strategies that are bound to ruin their venture 用 bound to"必定"把后果说死；原 文 may stain your reputation 只是"可能"损害声誉，并非必然毁掉事业。 B) ✓ 正确 behave unethically to win ↔resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals 与定位句"为赢而行不道德之 事"完全对应，与预判一致。 C) 无中生有 ignoring the huge labor cost 里的 labor cost"劳动成本"文中从未提及；第2段讲的是 忽视"如何取胜"的方式，不是忽视成本。 D) 偷换概念 winning at the current market level 把第3段 next level 的"层级"挪来，原文从未说陷 阱是"只盯当前市场层级"，属拼接错位。 建议创业者做什么来避免常常伴随竞争而来的陷阱? A) 慎重考虑什么才是真正重要的。 B) 优先考虑获取即时利益。 C) 评估长期后果。 D) 思考哪些成功是可以实现的。

questions.q: What are entrepreneurs advised to do to avoid traps that often accompany rivalry?
options: Deliberate on what really matters.
Prioritize reaping immediate benefits.
Estimate the long-term consequences.
Reflect on what successes are achievable.
questions.explain:
【判型】What are entrepreneurs advised to do 问作者建议的具体做法，答案是原文对策句的转 述，属细节题。

【拆句】What are entrepreneurs advised to do to avoid traps that often accompany rivalry： 被动结构 are advised to do（被建议做某事），to avoid… 是目的状语，that often accompany rivalry 是定语从句修饰 traps，accompany 意为"伴随"。

【定位】One way to avoid this trap is to stop and reflect on what's important. 避免这个陷阱的一个办法是停下来，反思什么才是重要的。 48. What are entrepreneurs advised to do to avoid traps that often accompany rivalry? A) Deliberate on what really matters. B) Prioritize reaping immediate benefits. C) Estimate the long-term consequences. D) Reflect on what successes are achievable.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 reflect on what's important ↔Deliberate on what really matters Deliberate on what really matters 精确对应对策句，与预判一致。 B) 与原文相反 Prioritize reaping immediate benefits"优先攫取眼前利益"恰与原文相悖：原文 the loss of your integrity will have long-term consequences 是提醒别只图短期，B 却让 人优先短期。 C) 偷换概念 Estimate the long-term consequences"评估长期后果"取自原文 long-term consequences，但那是说明丧失诚信的代价，并非作者建议的做法（作者建议是"反思 什么重要"）。 D) 偷换概念 Reflect on what successes are achievable 借用了原文 reflect on，却把宾语改成"哪 些成功可实现"；原文反思的对象是 what's important"什么重要"，而非"成功是否 可达"。 创业者如何避免做出冲动和不明智的决策? A) 通过让自己参与批判性思考。 B) 通过养成保持正直的习惯。 C) 通过批评自己以前的糟糕表现。 D) 通过克制自己不要对成功过于兴奋。

questions.q: How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions?
options: By engaging themselves in critical reasoning.
By developing a habit of keeping their integrity.
By criticizing themselves for previous poor performances.
By refraining from being too excited about their successes.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions 问避免冲动 决策的具体办法，答案直取原文方法句，属细节题。

【拆句】How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions：avoid 后 接动名词 making（avoid doing 固定用法），impulsive"冲动的"、insensible"不明智 的"两个形容词并列修饰 decisions。结构清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】But it's possible to avoid such costly mistakes by making a habit of engaging in critical thinking, such as considering opposing viewpoints and conducting cost-benefit analyses, especially for those decisions that are complex and can determine the future of your venture. 但可以通过养成进行批判性思考的习惯来避免这类代价高昂的错误，比如考虑相反的观点、 做成本收益分析，尤其是对那些复杂且能决定事业未来的决策。 49. How can entrepreneurs avoid making impulsive and insensible decisions? A) By engaging themselves in critical reasoning. B) By developing a habit of keeping their integrity. C) By criticizing themselves for previous poor performances. D) By refraining from being too excited about their successes.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 engaging in critical thinking ↔engaging themselves in critical reasoning engaging themselves in critical reasoning 精确对应对策句的方法，与预判一致。 B) 张冠李戴 keeping their integrity"保持诚信"是第2段针对"不道德行为"的对策，与本段"冲动决 策"无关，属跨段错位。 C) 偷换概念 criticizing themselves for previous poor performances"为以往糟糕表现自责"文中没 有依据；原文说的是 critical thinking 批判性思考，不是"自我批评"。 D) 偷换概念 refraining from being too excited about their successes"别为成功太兴奋"对错了对 象；原文 eagerness to win 指"求胜的急切"导致冲动，办法是批判性思考，而非"压抑 对成功的兴奋"。 创业者如何克服竞争带来的风险诱发效应? A) 通过密切关注他们当前的表现。 B) 通过采取可能危及对手成功的措施。 C) 通过监控他们的决策如何影响他们的心态。 D) 通过控制自己的情绪以避免做出糟糕的决策。

questions.q: How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry?
options: By paying close attention to their current performance.
By taking steps that stand to endanger their rivals' success.
By monitoring how their decision-making impacts their mentality.
By keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry 问克服风险效应 的具体方法，答案直取原文，属细节题。

【拆句】How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry：主干 How can entrepreneurs overcome the effects，risk-inducing（诱发风险的）作定语修饰 effects，of rivalry 是后置定语说明这种效应的来源。无陷阱。

【定位】One way you can overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry that stand to endanger your venture's success is to remain attentive to your emotional state and actively monitor how such feelings are affecting your decision-making. 你能克服这种危及事业成功的、由竞争诱发风险的效应的一个办法，是持续关注自己的情绪 状态，并主动监控这些情绪如何影响你的决策。 50. How can entrepreneurs overcome the risk-inducing effects of rivalry? A) By paying close attention to their current performance. B) By taking steps that stand to endanger their rivals' success. C) By monitoring how their decision-making impacts their mentality. D) By keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 paying close attention to their current performance 把对象换成 current performance"当前表现"；原文要关注的是 emotional state"情绪状态"，对象被换。 B) 与原文相反 taking steps that stand to endanger their rivals' success"采取危及对手成功的举 措"与原文相悖：原文 endanger your venture's success 担心的是危及"自己"的事业， 办法是管情绪，不是去害对手。 C) 与原文相反 monitoring how their decision-making impacts their mentality 说"监控决策如何影 响心态"，方向反了；原文是 how such feelings are affecting your decision- making"情绪如何影响决策"，主语宾语对调。 D) ✓ 正确 remain attentive to your emotional state ↔keeping their emotions in check how such feelings are affecting your decision-making ↔to avoid making poor decisions keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions 整体对应对策句 的两层意思，与预判一致。
